label: Eyewear
guidance: Record the actual eyewear and recurrence. Glasses candidates require ordinary spectacles; sunglasses, monocles and goggles remain distinct. Temporary use needs episode details. Verification alone does not establish eligibility for a future question.

label: Detective activity
guidance: Distinguish employed/private investigators, recurring amateur investigation, and former employment. Solving one mystery or having Detective in a name is insufficient. Record the period and adaptation.

label: Species or form
guidance: Cat means an actual feline identity or explicitly documented cat form. Ears, costumes, nicknames and catlike humanoids are not evidence of feline species. Transformation-only forms require explicit context. Unknown species is absence of a claim, never false.

label: Hair colour
guidance: Record explicit anime evidence, adaptation, period and form. Distinguish recurring traits from temporary appearances or transformations. Open values require a source-backed canonical name. This fact alone does not establish question eligibility; exclusions and combined conditions require editorial review.
